title: SillyTavern as an optional KDE6/Wayland desktop conversation client using its upstream Electron lifecycle
canonical_classification: OPTIONAL local KDE6/Wayland conversation desktop client; replaceable, on-demand and non-authoritative

accepted: KDE6 desktop launcher and user-session integration
optional system tray or launcher presentation without authority
optional push-to-talk as a client of existing FA3 STT/TTS authorities
human approval surface for side-effectful agent actions
rejected_or_reframed: PySide6/QWebEngine as a second mandatory SillyTavern browser wrapper
BLACKHOLE, SINGULARITY, EVENT HORIZON or ASCENSION as a new AI OS/kernel or orchestration authority
RAM/VRAM percentage routing as canonical scheduling policy
ad-hoc Oobabooga or KoboldCpp process spawning from the GUI
temporary-file subprocess execution described as a security sandbox
free-form shell, sudo, root systemctl, apt, dpkg or nft execution from the desktop client
runtime npm install/update on normal application launch
fixed GPU model/count or fixed SillyTavern server port assumptions

upstream_finding: SillyTavern 1.18.0 already contains src/electron/index.js and src/electron/start.sh. The Electron entrypoint starts the SillyTavern server and loads its event-derived URL in BrowserWindow, so a second PySide6/QWebEngine wrapper is unnecessary.
security_finding: The 1.18.0 release notes call out a third-party Bot Browser extension security incident; FA3 therefore requires separate extension admission and forbids automatic third-party extension installation/update.
